articles.summary: A new multi-display digital billboard for The Now and Orange Barrel Media (OBM) has been activated at the busiest intersection on Sunset Boulevard in West Hollywood, California, manufactured and installed by Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota.
articles.title: The Now’s Corner Cube Display Lights Up Advertising and Art on Sunset Boulevard from Daktronics

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, recently hosted its 7th annual High School Video Summit, a nationwide event designed to bring together high school video production teams, educators and industry professionals for a day of learning, collaboration and inspiration.
articles.title: Daktronics Hosts 7th Annual High School Video Summit

articles.summary: A new 11-display centerhung system graces Food City Center in Knoxville, Tennessee, as Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, has partnered with the University of Tennessee to design, manufacture and install a total of 24 LED displays.
articles.title: University of Tennessee Brings New View to Food City Center with 11-Display Centerhung System from Daktronics

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, will host Alicia Jeffreys, Executive Vice President and Chief Marketing Officer of the Detroit Pistons, as the next speaker for the Women In Sports Online Event.
articles.title: Daktronics Women In Sports Online Event Returns In August 2025
